	Over 150 healthcare workers trained in Emergency & Critical Care. Pre-conference Acute Care Nursing Workshop held at Era Lucknow Medical College Hands-on training at 12 skill stations to boost life-saving skills - Part of EMPARV International Conference.&nbsp
	Era University Strengthens Global Academic Partnerships: Era University, the University of the West Indies, and the American University of Barbados have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to foster meaningful collaboration in research, medical education, and academic exchange.&nbsp
	Spreading hope, one screen at a time: An inspiring awareness session on cancer screening & early diagnosis was held at Era Lucknow Medical College under the 'Anandi Maa - Ek Jeevan Bachao Abhiyan' and 'Cancer-Free India Yatra', in association with the Cancer Aid Society. Experts shared vital insights on cancer warning signs, targeted chemotherapy, oral cancer & tobacco risks, breast cancer screening & treatment, cervical cancer screening, and the power of HPV vaccination.&nbsp
	Nourishing little hearts with pure love: Era Lucknow Medical College & Hospital, together with RHTC Kakori, celebrated World Breastfeeding Week by spreading awareness at Naubasta village’s Anganwadi Centre.&nbsp
	Padma Shri Dr. Rajendra Prasad warns: Lung cancer is the top cause of cancer deaths globally. Early screening and quitting tobacco can save lives.&nbsp
	MBBS students of Era Lucknow Medical College shine in Integrated Quiz Competition: Anatomy, Physiology & Biochemistry students showcased their talent. Gold, Silver & Bronze medals awarded to winners.&nbsp
	A shining example of dedication and compassion: Heartiest congratulations to Dr. RK Garg on his well-deserved Lifetime Achievement Award. A legendary neurologist and a true servant of humanity.&nbsp
	A systematic review by experts from Era’s Lucknow Medical College & Hospital (Era University) and other institutions has revealed that Mycoplasma pneumoniae — usually known for causing lung infections — can also affect the brain and nervous system in some cases, leading to significant movement disorders.&nbsp
	One Tree in the Name of Mother – Era Medical College Organizes Massive Tree Plantation Drive.&nbsp
	World Blood Donor Day Observed in Lucknow On the occasion of World Blood Donor Day, a blood donation camp was organized at Era's Medical College and Hospital, Lucknow. A large number of students, doctors, and staff enthusiastically participated in the camp.&nbsp
	Government of Uttar Pradesh reaffirms strong commitment against tobacco use.Era Medical College, Lucknow, was praised for successfully running a dedicated Tobacco Cessation Centre and educating MBBS students on the dangers of tobacco.&nbsp
	Special workshop on "Human Approach and Ethical Practice of Medicine" Sadhvis from Divya Jyoti Jagriti Sansthan guide future doctors on ethics and humanity at Era Lucknow Medical College.&nbsp
	Era Medical College launches Shishu Maa Suraksha Scheme: Free normal and C-section deliveries, medicines, tests, meals, Rs. 2500 aid and baby kit for mothers from poor backgrounds. A beautiful step towards safer motherhood.&nbsp
	Sweet smiles, not sweet traps. Let's protect our youth from nicotine's hidden lure and gift them a healthier, brighter tomorrow.Our youth deserve a tobacco-free future.&nbsp
	Era University has launched the Shishu Maa Suraksha (SMS) Yojana, offering completely free normal & caesarean deliveries including medicines, diagnostics, surgery, food, and hospital stay for both mother and newborn.&nbsp
	Prestigious Padma Shri for Era’s Dr. Rajendra Prasad – The ‘Bhisham Pitamah’ of TB & Respiratory Medicine in India.&nbsp
	Spreading Awareness on World Schizophrenia Day.&nbsp
	Income Tax Department holds awareness drive on new Income Tax Act-2025 & Rules-2026 at Era Medical College, Lucknow. Focus on transparency, timely reporting & voluntary tax compliance.&nbsp
	Era Medical College Launches Free Delivery Revolution in Lucknow! Under the new 'Era Shishu-Maa Suraksha (SMS)' Scheme, both normal and cesarean deliveries, along with medicines, tests, food, ₹2500 nutritional support, and a baby kit, will now be completely free for mothers and newborns. A pioneering step by a private medical college towards maternal and child safety.&nbsp
	The First Breath: A Matter of Life and Death. At Era’s Lucknow Medical College & Hospital, doctors and nursing staff were empowered with advanced Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) training on Mother’s Day under the National Neonatology Forum (NNF), India.&nbsp
	Empowering Young Hearts: Era's Medical College shines a light on High Blood Pressure awareness among youth. Together with Omron Healthcare, future doctors & nurses learned the importance of correct BP monitoring and timely action. Because prevention is sweeter than cure.&nbsp
	World Asthma Day Awareness Program at Era Medical College, Lucknow. Breath is Life. Ensuring anti-inflammatory inhalers for every asthma patient is the real message. Together, let’s control asthma and save lives.&nbsp
	Awareness Programme on World Malaria Day 2026 at Era's Lucknow Medical College and Hospital.&nbsp
	Uttar Pradesh’s District Hospitals Now Successfully Managing Complex Delivery Cases Thanks to RRTC initiative RRTC at Era's Lucknow Medical College (Era Medical College), Lucknow is playing a vital role in this hub-and-spoke mentoring model, providing on-site training, continuous mentoring, and skill enhancement to doctors from attached district hospitals.&nbsp
	Collective efforts are key to eliminating Tuberculosis. Special Guest Lecture organized by the Department of Community Medicine, Era's Lucknow Medical College on World TB Day.&nbsp
	Spreading hope and awareness on World TB Day ,Dr. Karthi Vijay’s inspiring lecture at Era’s Lucknow Medical College reminded us - timely testing and regular treatment can defeat TB.&nbsp
	Celebrating Uttar Pradesh's pride: Doordarshan UP's new series 'Hamare Nayak' honors 26 Padma awardees from the state. Starts with litterateur Vidya Bindu Singh → Airs every Fri, Sat, Sun at 7:30 PM. Don't miss the inspiring stories of Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Anup Jalota, Malini Awasthi, Ram Saran Verma & many more.&nbsp
	World Hearing Day initiative by Era's Lucknow Medical College ENT Dept! Awareness drive at Udaan Public School focused on kids' ear health: safe headphone use, loud noise protection, infection prevention, live hearing screenings, student skits, teacher quizzes, and expert talks on early detection. Let's prioritize hearing care in schools & communities.&nbsp
	Technology (including AI and smart systems) plays a key role in reducing errors, providing alerts for vital signs, supporting clinical decisions, and enabling smarter ICUs.&nbsp
	Dr. Rajendra Prasad (from Era's Lucknow Medical College, Pulmonary Department) emphasized that timely CT scans, biopsies, and imaging enable accurate detection. Early intervention improves both quality of life and survival.&nbsp
	Building a Culture of Safety: Patient Safety Conclave-2026 at Era's Lucknow Medical College Highlights How Smart ICUs, Clinical Decision Support, and Humble Error Recognition Can Transform Healthcare.&nbsp

541: Study Programme : The total duration of the course is 54 months (4 1/2 yrs.) The structure and content of the syllabus is based on guidelines laid down by the Medical Council of India. The course is divided in 9 semesters of 6 months each.

530: Rules for Fellowship/Post Doctoral Certificate Courses (PDCC) 
531:at Era University, Lucknow 
532- 
--
536- 
537: Various Teaching Departments of Era’s Lucknow Medical College and Hospital, Era University, Lucknow, are offering Post Doctoral Certificate Course (PDCC) and Fellowship program (as per the details annexed herewith). 
538- At present these trainings cannot be registered as qualification by regulatory bodies. 
539: These courses will be of one year duration. Candidates will have to complete the predetermined period of training. In case the candidate leaves in between the certificate will not be awarded. 
540- Selected candidates will be appointed as Senior Residents and will receive a stipend accordingly. Senior Residency may be renewable for 2 more years. 
541: Eligibility for admission : MD/MS/DNB. 
542: These courses have been tailored to impart skills and to develop competency in those skills. 
543: Teaching and training for each certificate course and fellowship in various departments will be as per a structured program. 
544: Admission Criteria : 
545: Admissions will be strictly on the basis of performance in the interview which will be conducted by a board constituted by the Hon’ble Vice Chancellor. NEET /NBE Exam score will be taken into consideration while selecting a candidate. 
546- Record of candidates will be maintained by the Dean and the Registrar. 
547: Exit Exam will be conducted by the Era University at the end of the course. 
548: The Course Certificate will be awarded at a Convocation/Foundation Day of the Era University after certification by the Head and Dean regarding attendance, training, competency and completion of the predetermined duration and the result of the Exit Examination. 
549- Candidates will be enrolled with the Era University and will be issued an enrollment number. 
550: All candidates will be required to have a University ID signed by the authorized person that will remain valid for the course duration only. 
551- Library facilities will be provided to the candidates. 
552- All University rules regarding attendance and discipline, etc. must be maintained by the candidates as is done by all other university students. 
553: Hostel accommodation is available on chargeable as per the University norms. 
554- Candidates involved in direct patient care should have all regulatory approvals. For example, they must be registered with U.P. State Medical Council and have a valid registration number and additional degrees must be registered. 
555: To apply the candidates may download the form from the ELMC&H website and mail it at admissions@elmcindia.org or submit the form at Era University (Admission Cell). 
556- Candidates will have to present the following documents at the time of the interview: 
557- 
558: Original degree/certificates/pass certificates 
559- Mark sheets of all examinations passed 
560: Character certificate 
561- Two passport size photographs

2.  Undergraduate (M.B.B.S.)

Era's Lucknow Medical College :

Era's Lucknow Medical College offers BACHELOR OF MEDICINE AND BACHELOR OF SURGERY (M.B.B.S.). It is a comprehensive medical institute having excellent infrastructure & maintaining high Academic standards.

Affiliation & Recognition :

Affiliated to Era University, Lucknow.
Recognised by Medical Council of India (MCI) and Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India vide Notification No. U.12012/108/96-ME (P-II) dated 05.04.2006

Intake Capacity :
The intake capacity of the college for the first year M.B.B.S. Class is 250.

Eligibility :

Age - The candidate should have completed 17 year of age on 31st December of the year in which admission is sought.

Qualification - The candidate should have passed in English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology at 10+2 Intermediate, ICSE, CBSE or any equivalent examination securing a minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry & Biology taken together. For SC/ST/OBC category candidates, the required percentage in Physics, Chemistry & Biiology taken together is 40%.

Study Programme : The total duration of the course is 54 months (4 1/2 yrs.) The structure and content of the syllabus is based on guidelines laid down by the Medical Council of India. The course is divided in 9 semesters of 6 months each.

[]

First Professional

  Semester     Duration   Semester
  ------------ ---------- ---------------------
  Semester 1   6 months   Anatomy, Physiology
  Semester 2   6 months   Biochemistry

Second Professional

  Semester     Duration   Semester
  ------------ ---------- -------------------------
  Semester 3   6 months   Pathology, Microbiology
  Semester 4   6 months   Pharmacology
  Semester 5   6 months   Forensic Medicine

Third Professional Part- I

  Semester     Duration   Semester
  ------------ ---------- ---------------------------------------
  Semester 6   6 months   Ophthalamology, Oto-Rhino-Laryngology
  Semester 7   6 months   Social and Preventive Medicine

Third Professional Part- II

  Semester     Duration   Semester
  ------------ ---------- ------------------------------
  Semester 8   6 months   Medicine Surgery Paediatrics
  Semester 9   6 months   Medicine Surgery Paediatrics

The Final Professional Examination is held after the completion of the 9th semester. It is followed by a one year "compulsory rotatory internship". After successful completion of the internship the candidate is awarded the MBBS degree.

Download Application form

Rules for Fellowship/Post Doctoral Certificate Courses (PDCC) at Era University, Lucknow

1.  Various Teaching Departments of Era’s Lucknow Medical College and Hospital, Era University, Lucknow, are offering Post Doctoral Certificate Course (PDCC) and Fellowship program (as per the details annexed herewith).
2.  At present these trainings cannot be registered as qualification by regulatory bodies.
3.  These courses will be of one year duration. Candidates will have to complete the predetermined period of training. In case the candidate leaves in between the certificate will not be awarded.
4.  Selected candidates will be appointed as Senior Residents and will receive a stipend accordingly. Senior Residency may be renewable for 2 more years.
5.  Eligibility for admission: MD/MS/DNB.
6.  These courses have been tailored to impart skills and to develop competency in those skills.
7.  Teaching and training for each certificate course and fellowship in various departments will be as per a structured program.
8.  Admission Criteria:
    Admissions will be strictly on the basis of performance in the interview which will be conducted by a board constituted by the Hon’ble Vice Chancellor. NEET /NBE Exam score will be taken into consideration while selecting a candidate.
9.  Record of candidates will be maintained by the Dean and the Registrar.
10. Exit Exam will be conducted by the Era University at the end of the course.
11. The Course Certificate will be awarded at a Convocation/Foundation Day of the Era University after certification by the Head and Dean regarding attendance, training, competency and completion of the predetermined duration and the result of the Exit Examination.
12. Candidates will be enrolled with the Era University and will be issued an enrollment number.
13. All candidates will be required to have a University ID signed by the authorized person that will remain valid for the course duration only.
14. Library facilities will be provided to the candidates.
15. All University rules regarding attendance and discipline, etc. must be maintained by the candidates as is done by all other university students.
16. Hostel accommodation is available on chargeable as per the University norms.
17. Candidates involved in direct patient care should have all regulatory approvals. For example, they must be registered with U.P. State Medical Council and have a valid registration number and additional degrees must be registered.
18. To apply the candidates may download the form from the ELMC&H website and mail it at admissions@elmcindia.org or submit the form at Era University (Admission Cell).
19. Candidates will have to present the following documents at the time of the interview:
    1.  Original degree/certificates/pass certificates
    2.  Mark sheets of all examinations passed
    3.  Character certificate
    4.  Two passport size photographs
    5.  Self attested ID & address proof
20. Registration fees will be payable after the completion of admission process.

PDCC/Fellowship Fee Structure

  Fee                 Amount
  ------------------- -------------------------
  Registration Fees   Rs. 50,000
  Examination Fee     As per university norms
  Stipend             Rs. 1,10,000 per month

Era's School of Nursing

1.  Home
2.  Era's School of Nursing

Era's School of Nursing

Era's School of Nursing managed by the Era Educational Trust and associated with Era's Lucknow Medical College and Hospital offers 3½ year diploma course in General Nursing and Midwifery (G.N.M.) and 2 year course in Auxiliary Nurse & Midwife (A.N.M.).
The School of Nursing is recognized by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and is affiliated to the UP State Medical Faculty. The number of seats in G.N.M. (Dip.) is 100 & A.N.M.is 40.
Candidates who have qualified in the 10+2 or equivalent examination and are in the age group of 17 to 35 years are eligible for admission. Admission is based on a written examination, followed by an interview. Candidates can also join the course with an agreement to serve at Era Hospital for 2 to 3 years. They are offered very attractive terms during their training and service within the agreement period. Internship after training is mandatory as per the norms laid down by the Indian Nursing Council.
These courses are affiliated from the UP State medical Faculty (UPSMFAC).

About Era's Medical College

1.  Home
2.  About

Era Educational Trust

Era Educational Trust (EET) was started in 2001 by the approval of the Medical Council of India (MCI), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and the Government of India, and received recognition in 2006. With an aim to remodel education from being a cluster of well-understood subjects to becoming well-adapted aspects and principles of life, the Era Educational Trust conceptualized Era's Lucknow Medical College and Hospital. EET aspires to inculcate traits of honesty, compassion, courage, persistence and responsibility among students, so as to enable them to become competent doctors with good clinical knowledge as well as instill in them ethics and values by which they can treat their patients with a human touch.

[]

- [about icon]

  Vision

  To be a centre of excellence in teaching, training, research, innovation and medical care facilities by attracting best talents, brains and manpower for the benefit of the society as a whole.

- [about icon]

  Mission

  Our mission is to curate, create and disseminate knowledge and academic excellence so as to produce graduates and postgraduates who are fully prepared to achieve highest level of personal and professional distinction. Furthermore, we work to provide health care facilities to all classes of masses, including poorest of the poor and downtrodden and offer medical care which is Accessible, Available and Affordable.

Teaching Hospital

ELMC&H is a leading teaching hospital for undergraduate medical training as well as postgraduate and advanced training of specialist doctors, nurses and allied health professionals. It has been recognized as one of the best in the country. Among more than 500 government and private medical colleges of India, ELMC has been ranked 9^(th), 11^(th) and 32^(nd) by Outlook, The Week and India Today, respectively in 2025. It is affiliated with Era University, one of the most sought-after institute, located in Lucknow. It is also recognized by Government of India and Medical Council of India, New Delhi and listed with the World Directories of Medical Schools, WHO/ AVICENNA and IMED/FAIMER directories.
The college has been functioning as a "Centre of Excellence" in medical education, healthcare, training and research for almost two decades. Besides 250 undergraduate (MBBS) seats it also offers postgraduate degree in 19 subjects (100 seats) which include General Medicine, General Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Radiology, Paediatrics, Dermatology, Venerology & Leprosy, Anaesthesiology, Psychiatry, Tuberculosis & Respiratory Medicine, Oto-Rhino-Laryngology, Ophthalmology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Community Medicine, Bio Chemistry, Pathology, Anatomy and Physiology. Recently Fellowship / Post Doctoral Certificate Courses (PDCC) of 1 year duration were also started in various departments in order to alleviate the shortage of skilled and competent manpower that will benefit the society at large.

Patient Care

The hospital provides care for patients, training for doctors and other healthcare professionals, and conducts research to bring better care to its patients. ELMC has more than 1063 beds fully functional hospital facility, equipped with sophisticated, world class diagnostic and therapeutic equipment and supported by a highly qualified and dedicated faculty. Its super specialty departments of Cardiology, Neuro-Surgery, Urology, Paediatric-Surgery, Nephrology, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology and Oncology etc. provide expert advice and treatment. Empanelled under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme, the hospital provides free OPD and IPD services with subsidized charges for tests and treatments. Trauma and Emergency services are available round the clock. There are a dozen operation theatres (OT) accessible to this section, with adept medical officers assisted by a team of doctors and other ancillary staff managing this section. Shishu Maa Suraksha Yojana (SMS Yojana) is a commendable initiative at Era's Lucknow Medical College and Hospital to promote safe motherhood and ensure quality healthcare for mothers and newborns. This scheme aims to remove financial barriers for pregnant women by providing comprehensive, free maternal and child care services, enabling institutional deliveries without any out-of-pocket expenses.

Hospital Highlights

- One of the best Radiology Centre in the whole of North India with state-of-the-art MRI machine, spiral CT scanner, mammography machine, High-Resolution Colour Doppler, the latest Ultrasound machine, Mobile and Fixed X-Ray machines with IITV
- ICU is equipped with a central monitoring system, ventilators, defibrillator, blood gas analyzer, piped oxygen, suction and compressed air. For critical neonates requiring extra care, the hospital has hi-tech fully equipped specialized NICU
- Advance Linear Accelerator (Varian TRUEBEAM SVC) machine for radiation oncology.
- Neurosurgery and Trauma cases, Laparoscope Surgeries and Endoscopy performed on a routine basis.
- It received the prestigious SKOCH award for implementing and seamlessly executing the Ayushmann Bharat Scheme of the Govt of India.
- Immediate attention to medico-legal cases  
- In-house biomedical waste disposal facilities including an incinerator
- Doctors residential quarters are available in the campus to facilitate immediate patient care.
- Electricity generating plant which provides round the clock power supply.

24×7

- Emergency & Trauma Service Unit with a fleet of ambulances available
- Diagnostics Department which provides comprehensive pathology and radiology services
- Pharmacy well stocked with medicines & products
- Blood Bank operating round the clock

Patient-Directed Research

ELMC&H seeks to bring to its patients new and better care and therapies through research. It is the first medical institute in the country to establish the Department of Personalized and Molecular Medicine and is a registered 'National Referral Centre for Lead Poisoning in India'. Research is an integral part of our institutional practice. ELMC has the honor of being amongst the top 4.3% medical institutes of India (most active in the field of medical research), with more than 3346 published research articles in National and International and peer-reviewed journals. The university bi-annually publishes a multidisciplinary scientific journal titled Era's Journal of Medical Research (EJMR) which is indexed and peer reviewed. The university's national and international research collaborations provide a platform for exchange of knowledge.
Healthcare delivery in India has witnessed an extraordinary paradigm shift and we at Era promise to deliver the best and updated practices of healthcare through comprehensive integrated clinical practice, medical innovation and lifelong learning.

Era College of Nursing

Era College of Nursing offers a degree course in Nursing. The duration of the B.Sc Nursing course is 4 years and Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing is 2 years.


Eligibility :

Candidate in the age group of 17 years to 35 years are eligible for admission.


Educational Qalification :

For B.Sc. Nursing - Higher Secondary (10+2) with Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English).

Affiliation :

--- nursing school html exact ---

Era's School of Nursing

Era's School of Nursing managed by the Era Educational Trust and associated with Era's Lucknow Medical College and Hospital offers 3½ year diploma course in General Nursing and Midwifery (G.N.M.) and 2 year course in Auxiliary Nurse & Midwife (A.N.M.).
The School of Nursing is recognized by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and is affiliated to the UP State Medical Faculty. The number of seats in G.N.M. (Dip.) is 100 & A.N.M.is 40.
Candidates who have qualified in the 10+2 or equivalent examination and are in the age group of 17 to 35 years are eligible for admission. Admission is based on a written examination, followed by an interview. Candidates can also join the course with an agreement to serve at Era Hospital for 2 to 3 years. They are offered very attractive terms during their training and service within the agreement period. Internship after training is mandatory as per the norms laid down by the Indian Nursing Council.
These courses are affiliated from the UP State medical Faculty (UPSMFAC).
